method: Legacy per-anchor-logit Integrated Gradients with 32-step midpoint integration and centered finite differences
target: individual prospectivity logit for each anchor in the union of four target polygons
baseline: per-node-type mean of the 41 input feature channels
hard_constraints: three hard-constraint layers are held at their observed values throughout the path and are not attributed
perturbation: one feature channel is jointly shifted over all graph nodes, matching the archived legacy calculation
interpretation_note: Feature-wise IG dependence is an attribution diagnostic, not a Pearson/Spearman correlation or a causal effect.
